CONFIDENTIAL
File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.1, Special Branch Station,
REPORT
Date January 4, 19 40.
Subject Dah Yih Printing & Engraving Company.
Made by D. S. I. MacAdie, Forwarded by D. I. Crawford.

Attached report on the Dah Yih Printing &
Engraving Company has been shewn to the Consul
General through the medium of Mr. Ford and it is
learned that the factory reported on is not the
subject of the Consulate General's enquiries.
Careful enquiries from banking circles and
the printing trade confirm the statement in the
report of this office dated December 18th 1939 to
the effect that the Union Publishing & Printing
Company (Old Chung Hwa Book Co.) 469 Macao Road is
the only plant in Shanghai undertaking the printing
of subsidiary currency notes. No printing firm
bearing the name Dayeh is known in Shanghai and
no other American registered plant printing banknotes
can be traced in this port.

R. W. Mac Adie.
D. S. I.

D.C. (Special Branch).

主题：大业印刷雕刻公司。
制作人：副督察长 MacAdie，转呈人：督察长 Crawford。

附上的关于大业印刷雕刻公司的报告已通过 Ford 先生向总领事出示，据悉，该报告所述的工厂并非总领事馆查询的对象。
经向银行界及印刷业仔细查询，证实了本处于1939年12月18日报告中的陈述，即位于澳门路469号的联合出版印刷公司（原中华书局）是上海唯一承印辅币券的工厂。在上海未闻有名为“Dayeh”的印刷商，在本港也查不到其他在美注册并印制钞票的工厂。

R. W. Mac Adie.
副督察长。

REPORT
Date December 22, 19 39
Subject Dah Yih Printing and Engraving Company - factory in the
French Concession
Made by D.S.I. MacAdie Forwarded by D. I. Crawford

The Dah Yih (大業) Printing & Engraving
Company has a factory which is at present under
construction on a site at No. 301 Avenue Fetain
at the corner of Rue Prosper Paris. This
company is said to be a branch of Thomas de la
Rue & Company, noted printers of banknotes
etc., in Great Britain. According to the plans,
the factory will have accommodation, not only
working, but living, for 600 Chinese employees
and 14 British engineers. The factory is stated
to have bought up a large quantity of machinery
from Chinese printing concerns for use in the
plant. The main purpose of the factory, it is
said, is to print banknotes for the Chungking
Government but work on the building is at present
suspended due to opposition to the scheme from
the local French Authorities who feel that in
view of the new regulations forbidding the import
of banknotes, promulgated by the Customs at the
instance of the Japanese Authorities, the existence
of this plant would constitute an embarrassment
to the Concession. However, the whole matter
is stated to be a subject of negotiation between
the British, French and Chinese Governments.
In any case, the factory would not be in a position
to print banknotes for another six months.

日期 1939年12月22日
主题：大业印刷雕刻公司——位于法租界的工厂
制作人：副督察长 MacAdie 转呈人：督察长 Crawford

大业（大業）印刷雕刻公司在费泰恩路（Avenue Fetain）与普罗斯珀·巴黎路（Rue Prosper Paris）转角处的301号地块上有一座正在建设中的工厂。据称，该公司是英国著名钞票等印刷商 Thomas de la Rue & Company 的分公司。根据规划，该工厂不仅将为600名中国员工和14名英国工程师提供工作场所，还将提供住宿。据说该工厂已从多家中国印刷企业购买了大量机器设备用于该厂。据称，该工厂的主要目的是为重庆政府印制钞票，但由于当地法国当局反对该计划，目前的建设工作已暂停；法国当局认为，鉴于海关在日本当局要求下颁布了禁止进口钞票的新规，该工厂的存在将使租界陷入尴尬境地。然而，据说整个事件是英、法、中三国政府之间的谈判议题。无论如何，该工厂在六个月内将无法具备印制钞票的条件。

（批注：督察长（特别分处）
此报告似乎与
总领事馆的备忘录不符。
建议出示给
Ford 先生，他可能会
咨询总领事）

British Consulate-General,
SHANGHAI,
20th December 1939.

Dear Bourne,

Thank you for your letter of 18th December
on the subject of the two American factories printing
Chinese Government bank notes.

The Embassy have now received information
to the effect that the names of the two companies in
question are Dayeh and Chung Hwa. It is understood
that the latter is closely associated with the Chung
Hwa Book Company, Ltd., (this confirms the information
contained in your letter). The former is to all
intents and purposes a branch of the Dayeh Engraving
and Printing Company, Ltd., the head office of which
is in the Bank of China Building in Hongkong with
workshops at No. 68, Robinson Road, Hong Kong.

Possibly this information may assist you to
trace the "Dayeh" factory, if such exists. I should
be grateful for any particulars you can get on this
matter.

With apologies for troubling you further.

Yours sincerely,

CONFIDENTIAL

Major K. M. Bourne, M.C.,
Commissioner of Police,
SHANGHAI.

（印：SHANGHAI COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 21 DEC 1939）

DC (Sp Br)
* Enquiry please
page_data.zh:
英国驻上海总领事馆，
上海，
1939年12月20日。

亲爱的 Bourne，

感谢您12月18日关于两家印制中国政府钞票的美国工厂的来信。

大使馆现已收到消息，称这两家公司的名称分别为“Dayeh”和“Chung Hwa”。据悉，后者与中华书局有限公司（Chung Hwa Book Company, Ltd.）关系密切（这证实了您信中所载的信息）。前者实际上就是大业雕刻印刷有限公司（Dayeh Engraving and Printing Company, Ltd.）的分支机构，其总公司位于香港中国银行大厦，车间位于香港罗便臣道68号。

或许这些信息能协助您追踪“Dayeh”工厂（如果确实存在的话）。如能获取有关此事的任何详情，我将不胜感激。

为再次打扰您而致歉。

此致
敬礼，

机密

K. M. Bourne 少校，M.C.,
警务总监，
上海。

（印章：上海总监办公室 1939年12月21日）

December 18, 1939.

The Union Publishing & Printing Coy, 469 Macao Road.
------------------

As far as can be ascertained from banking
circles, the Union Publishing and Printing Coy, 469
Macao Road, is the only printing plant in Shanghai
which at present undertakes the printing of subsidiary
notes for the Chinese banks. This printing company
is really the old Chung Hwa Book Company (Telephone
Book Page 41 indicates that the general office of the
old Chung Hwa Book Coy is located at this address).
They obtained American registration following the
withdrawal of the Chinese troops from the Shanghai area
and this was carried out to avoid Japanese intervention.

联合出版印刷公司，澳门路469号。
------------------

据从银行界了解到的情况，位于澳门路469号的联合出版印刷公司是上海目前唯一承印中国银行辅币券的印刷厂。这家印刷公司实际上是原中华书局（电话簿第41页显示，原中华书局的总办事处位于此地址）。在中国军队撤出上海地区后，他们进行了在美注册，此举是为了避免日本的干涉。

SHANGHAI.

Dear Sir Herbert, CONFIDENTIAL

With reference to your note of December 20,
enquiries in banking circles and the printing trade
elicit the information that the Union Publishing &
Printing Company (old Chung Hwa Book Co.), 469 Macao
Road, is the only plant in Shanghai undertaking the
printing of subsidiary currency notes. No printing
firm bearing the name Dayeh is known in Shanghai
and no other American registered plant printing
banknotes can be traced.

Yours sincerely,

Sd. K. M. Bourne.
Commissioner of Police.
